title: Replication Package for "Process Mining and Stochastic Modeling for Software Process Forecasting: A Systematic Mapping Study with an LLM-Assisted Protocol"
description: Version 2.0.0 of the replication artefact for a systematic mapping study at the intersection of process mining, stochastic modeling, and machine-learning forecasting applied to software-development processes (IST round-1 revision). Includes: search strings for five databases (Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, Springer Link, Web of Science); eligibility window January 1994–December 2025, searches executed 12 April 2026; deduplication, enrichment, and screening pipelines; LLM screening prompts and JSON schemas (claude-haiku-4-5 primary, claude-sonnet-4-6 verifier); 8-criterion quality-assessment rubric (Dyba and Dingsoyr, 2008); cross-model Cohen's kappa; blind human double-screening sheets and human–LLM kappa (T/A n=468, FT n=177); cross-tier deduplicated included-study list (404 raw → 340 distinct; 318 analytical); PRISMA snapshot; SEGRESS checklist; EC5 audit; sensitivity analysis. PDFs of primary studies are not redistributed (copyright); DOIs are in results/final_review/included_studies_340.csv. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20130276.

Independent human double-screening is included. LLM tools are not listed as authors. Access must be Open (SEGRESS item 27).
